lines: He bears all thirty-six truths, framed with windows in every limb —
his own flesh or another's, pot or shard, is God's own house.
sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭtriṃśattattvabhṛtaṃ vigraharacanāgavākṣaparipūrṇam | nijam anyad atha śarīraṃ ghaṭādi vā tasya devagṛham

lines: There sits the goddess, highest self, great Bhairava Śiva —
joined to her own powers, worshipped with gifts of inward grasp.
sanskrit_cite: tatra ca paramātmamahābhairavaśivadevatāṃ svaśaktiyutām | ātmāmarśanavimaladravyaiḥ paripūjayann āste

lines: Heap the seeds of every quarrel between within and without —
in his bright fire of knowing: no effort in the giving.
sanskrit_cite: bahirantaraparikalpanabhedamahābījanicayam arpayataḥ | tasyātidīptasaṃvijjvalane yatnād vinā bhavati homaḥ

lines: His prayer never sets. The blessed Lord makes many shapes —
and that bright making is itself his prayer.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānam anastamitaṃ punar eṣa hi bhagavān vicitrarūpāṇi | sṛjati tad eva dhyānaṃ saṃkalpālikhitasatyarūpatvam

lines: Turn worlds and doctrines and the host of sense within —
and that, they say, is his soft prayer.
sanskrit_cite: bhuvanāvalīṃ samastāṃ tattvakramakalpanām athākṣagaṇam | antarbodhe parivartayati ca yat so 'sya japa uditaḥ

lines: See all with level eyes, rest content in knowing —
love the burning ground, and hold the body as a staff topped with a skull.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ samayā dṛṣṭyā yat paśyati yac ca saṃvidaṃ manute | viśvaśmaśānaniratāṃ vigrahakhaṭvāṅgakalpanākalitām

lines: He tastes the world's sweet sap from his own hand's bowl —
shard of the known. Hard the vow, and easy too.
sanskrit_cite: viśvarasāsavapūrṇaṃ nijakaragaṃ vedyakha.ṅdakakapālam | rasayati ca yat tad etad vratam asya sudurlabhaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca

lines: So past birth and death, named for the highest Lord —
arrived, and shining with the finder, done with doing, stands at ease.
sanskrit_cite: iti janmanāśahīnaṃ paramārthamaheśvarākhyam upalabhya | upalabdhṛtāprakāśāt kṛtakṛtyas tiṣṭhati yatheṣṭam

lines: All filling, all self, as told, all quarrel shaken off —
bliss past compare. Who knows is made of that.
sanskrit_cite: vyāpinam abhihitam itthaṃ sarvātmānaṃ vidhūtanānātvam | nirupamaparamānandaṃ yo vetti sa tanmayo bhavati
